name: Camper daylight surplus battery charge UI capture
preconditions: Use a disposable save with a camper body, enabled solar bank with cells, enabled battery bank with a partly discharged original car battery, full sunlight, daytime and zero external demand. Open camper Energy Management through its actual radial action and select the battery-bank card so component charge bars are visible. Compare authoritative /energy native battery UseTimes before and after the wait; a lower value proves charging. With the battery and generator switched off, verify that solar alone cannot enable POI lights. Night/shade, slow driving, save/reload and remote-client checks remain separate qualifications.
